game: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Turtles in Time Re-Shelled
project: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Turtles in Time Re-Shelled Recompiled
approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 XBLA version to native PC code using ReXGlue
notes: Public native PC release with Windows and experimental Linux/Steam Deck builds, TRG launcher, rendering up to 4x resolution, online co-op for up to four players, offline achievements and an unofficial Brazilian Portuguese translation
